sn_aia_team.description: Analyzes all panelist interview feedback for a given interview round and produces a weighted synthesis. Aggregates scores, identifies consensus patterns, highlights convergent strengths/concerns across panelists, and generates a structured recommendation. Goes beyond simple vote counting to identify nuanced patterns in verbatim feedback.
sn_aia_team.name: AEGIS Feedback Synthesizer
